acceptances.rationale: Time-bounded acceptance for the reviewed Hardhat build and CI dependency path only; the advisory is absent from production runtime images.
compensating_controls: Frozen lockfile and reviewed build inputs
Production images use isolated production-only dependency closures
Trivy production-image policy requires zero Critical and zero High
Gitleaks, CodeQL, Node audit, and SBOM SHA-binding remain mandatory
